task: Pin the Narwhal IDP Portal image to the published release 1.1.1 (was 1.1.0); static change only, live rollout not part of this change.

events.summary: Tag bump of one image in the GitOps manifest, its air-gap inventory and digest pin, and the docs that quote the pin. No manifest structure, env, RBAC or chart change. No cluster access, no PR, no merge.

ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.1 was published by portal-docker-publish run 39971656742 (arm64 and amd64 builds, manifest, signing succeeded). crane digest on the tag returned sha256:e8b137dc7979896d8eeb13fd3eec7a5e19a7b36c2474831a9e871765e63614df, equal to the digest reported by the release lane; cosign verify with scripts/airgap/keys/cosign.pub passes on that digest.

Pin moved 1.1.0 -> 1.1.1 in the Deployment image, images.txt and image-digests.tsv (new digest, crane digest method), gitops README pins (en/ko), VERSIONS.md (also corrects the stale Next.js 16.2.1 to 16.4.2), compatibility-matrix, SECURITY.md example and the Unreleased changelog entries.
See evidence for the commands run and their results. Live rollout is not part of the change and is not verified: no running portal pod was checked for the reported version.
evidence: test:make test (RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_DIR set) -> passed 406 failed 0 warnings 3
test:make validate -> exit 0, all YAML files OK
test:bash scripts/ci/check-version-consistency.sh -> All checked versions are consistent
test:scripts/airgap/lib/refresh-image-digests.sh --check -> image-digests.tsv is current (no upstream tag movement detected)
